functionality.rationale: The loader repair must make both legacy execution and export resolution run rather than merely bypass them.

security.rationale: Windows DLL search directories must be explicit, existing test-process paths and scoped to the probe lifetime.

performance.rationale: The probe registers a bounded set of existing PATH entries before loading one library.

compatibility.rationale: The fix must execute the frozen v1 client and resolve all required exports on Windows.

concurrency.rationale: The loader setup and probes remain single-process and introduce no concurrent behavior.

platform.rationale: The task changes Windows-only CTest and Python loader behavior while preserving macOS and Linux.

persistence.rationale: DLL search setup is process-local and creates no persisted product state.

adr.rationale: The repair executes existing ABI evidence and does not change ADR 0001 or ADR 0003.

architecture.rationale: Only internal test-process DLL resolution changes.

roadmap.rationale: The repair restores a quality gate and does not complete a product milestone.

acceptance.note: Accepted by the integration owner after repository verification.
